posts.title: A Lost Tape
posts.description: A 1973 copy of UNIX v4 was recently discovered in a closet at the University of Utah. The tape, which was evidently sent by Ken Thompson himself, is on its way to the Computer History Museum, in the hope that they have the hardware to read it. The post A Lost Tape appeared first on Faces of Open Source .

posts.title: Evolution of The Unix Codebase
posts.description: Just discovered that Diomidis Spinellis has created The Unix History repository on GitHub. This repository contains the full source trees of Unix releases over the last 43 years from the Epoch at Bell Labs in 1972 through to the FreeBSD 10.1.0 in 2015.
